originalBug.cause: restore_api_names matched source and Chinese anchors by occurrence order. Chinese sentence reordering plus multiple members sharing a category URL replaced a correct API name with a different name.

cases.reviewedPreparedText: 未设置 X2 和 X3 时， X0 AWS SDK for .NET 的凭据与配置文件解析链 X1 会提供凭据。在生产环境中，应优先使用 IAM 角色等工作负载凭据，而不是长期密钥。当部署环境要求显式配置 SDK 时，可以使用 X4 、 X5 、 X6 和 X7 Token X8 。配置文件的设置方式请参阅 X9 AWS CLI 配置文件参考 X10 。
X0 和 X1 的默认值均为 30 秒。超时后，Orleans 会取消传给 X4、X5 以及 Grain 生命周期参与者的 X2 CancellationToken X3，然后等待这些代码执行完成。在这些回调返回之前，激活实例会保留其 Grain 目录注册和激活实例作用域内的服务。如果激活超时，激活会在回调返回后失败。如果停用超时，停用会在回调返回后继续。

intermediateRegression.reviewedPreparedText: X0 让调用 X1 与持久延迟 X2 竞速。运行时记录延迟的到期时间，因此停用后的回放仍保留原截止时间：超时从首次运行开始计时。如果延迟先到期，调用会收到原因为 X3 的取消请求，而 X4 等待承运商的结果。若调用以取消状态结束，则引发 X5 TimeoutException X6，其内部异常是该调用的 X7；如果承运商仍然返回报价，则将该报价作为结果。如果调用先完成，X8 会取消延迟，并返回调用结果或引发其失败。X9 接受的则是绝对截止时间。
intermediateRegression.sourceHtml: DurableTaskExtensions.WaitAsync races the call, ground-quote/0, with a durable delay, ground-quote/1. The runtime records the delay’s due time, so a replay after a deactivation keeps the original deadline: the timeout counts from the first run. When the delay elapses first, the call receives a cancellation request with the reason The operation timed out after 00:02:00., and WaitAsync waits for the carrier’s outcome. A call which ends canceled throws TimeoutException, whose inner exception is the call’s OperationCanceledException; a quote which the carrier returns anyway is the result. When the call completes first, WaitAsync cancels the delay and returns the call’s result or throws its failure. WaitUntilAsync takes an absolute deadline instead.
intermediateRegression.cause: The first href-group implementation collected only simple source identifiers, so a qualified API label sharing the category URL was omitted from the ambiguity set.
intermediateRegression.discovery: The first full rebuilt corpus audit caught this edge case before final pass. It was not suppressed; the helper and exact final paragraph were corrected.

defectsAndFixes.finalHelperPolicy: Group every original API-link label by href, including qualified names and navigation labels. Preserve labels already valid for the href; only repair an unknown label when the entire source candidate set contains exactly one eligible canonical API name. Do not infer among multiple candidates.
defectsAndFixes.helperEditScope: Only restore_api_names in scripts/build_site.py was edited by this agent.

limitations: This audit starts from the captured structured source. Raw official HTML-to-structured extraction/presentation coverage is the independent source-presentation audit; that separate result is not silently inferred from these checks.
No browser was used. Parent/root owns live SVG geometry, restored icons, responsive layout, actual file:// behavior, visual styles and interaction checks.
External hyperlinks retain faithful source targets but were not fetched for live HTTP availability.

Residual natural English relies on the prior independent read review plus verified input hashes and exactly four approved terminology deltas. This run is not a new complete semantic reread of every translation.
Original image bytes are preserved; this audit does not claim OCR or new translation of text embedded inside original raster/SVG images.

The final status is bound to the recorded current payload and app hashes. Later payload changes require relevant content checks; frontend-only changes require an incremental script/reference/visual check.
publicationReadinessForThisScope: All final content and static/runtime dependency checks pass. This agent has stopped repository writes; root may freeze the audited payloads while completing its separate browser/presentation checks.
